title: Copy files using a custom SSH port
summary: If your remote server uses a non-standard SSH port (not 22), use the -P flag with scp to specify the correct port number for the connection.
prerequisites: Know the custom SSH port number

steps.explain: Use the -P flag to specify the port number when connecting to the remote host.

placeholders.name: PORT
placeholders.description: The SSH port number on the remote host

placeholders.name: LOCAL_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file on your computer

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: Hostname or IP of the remote computer

placeholders.name: REMOTE_FILE
placeholders.description: Destination path on the remote computer
